payload.unit_title: R21 Major Project Consolidated Print Report (M2.3)
payload.objective: Perform a read-only architectural analysis of the R21 Major Project Consolidated Print Report and determine the concrete implementation slices required to migrate it into the existing CampusLynk report architecture.
payload.explicit_request: Review the read-only architectural analysis for task 'M2.3-ANALYZE-001'. Confirm whether the decomposition into 8 modular partials, Master Shell <x-layouts.report-layout> usage, and two-slice implementation plan are approved, and issue TASK_DISPATCH for Slice 1 (M2.3-IMPLEMENT-001). Return decision: 'TASK_DISPATCH' with payload.task_dispatch.

task_report.summary: Read-only architectural analysis completed for M2.3. Legacy 1,025-line print monolith decomposed into 8 modular Blade partials (< 160 lines each) extending <x-layouts.report-layout>. Covers all 5 statutory report types (group breakdown, CIA register, SBTE statement, ESE 8-rubrics, consolidated register). Reuses shared institutional header and signatures. Proposed 2-slice implementation plan with Slice 1 (M2.3-IMPLEMENT-001) as first concrete task.

payload.reason: The M2.3 read-only analysis is sufficient to authorize the first implementation slice. M2.2 is completed and satisfies the dependency, while the legacy 1,025-line print monolith has been fully inventoried across all five statutory report modes. The proposed decomposition into a root report view plus shared header/signatures and five report-specific partials preserves the legacy functional surface while satisfying the mandatory sub-500-line Blade rule. The report must use the existing x-layouts.report-layout as the institutional A4 print shell; extending that existing shell for portrait/landscape behavior is preferable to creating any duplicate print framework. Existing x-ui.* components must be reused wherever applicable, with no raw tables or ad-hoc print UI where an established component exists. The controller wantsJson correction is appropriately bounded to preserve JSON/API behavior without introducing new backend scope. Slice 1 is therefore approved for implementation, with Slice 2 remaining separately gated for dedicated feature-test expansion and final checkpoint verification.

task_dispatch.objective: Implement the R21 Major Project consolidated print-report architecture by enhancing the existing report-layout shell and replacing the 1,025-line legacy print monolith with modular report Blade partials covering all five statutory report types.
instructions: Implement only the approved Slice 1 scope after re-inspecting the current target files and legacy source as needed.

Enhance the existing <x-layouts.report-layout> only as required to support the M2.3 A4 print requirements, including portrait/landscape orientation where justified by the report type. Do not create a second report shell or print framework.

Create the modular M2.3 root report view and the shared institutional header, statutory signatures, group breakdown, CIA register, SBTE submission, ESE 8-rubric score sheet, and consolidated broad-register partials according to the approved decomposition.
Preserve all five legacy report modes and their documented statutory fields, calculations, marks-in-words content, examiner/signature requirements, and page-break behavior.
Reuse existing CampusLynk x-ui.* components where applicable. Do not introduce duplicate table, card, badge, button, icon, modal, or form infrastructure.
Keep every Blade file at or below 500 lines and preserve modular separation rather than recreating the legacy monolith in a different file.
Apply the minimal printReport() request-negotiation correction only if repository inspection confirms the reported JSON/view negotiation issue still exists.
Do not expand into M2.4 or implement the dedicated M2.3 feature-test slice yet.
Run the agreed syntax and existing R21 controller verification after implementation.
Return a TASK_REPORT with exact changed files, line counts, report-mode coverage, design-system compliance, tests/results, scope compliance, issues, and git status. Do not commit.
constraints: Do not modify migrations, database schema, User.php, unrelated controllers/models/services, routes, control-plane files, or tests in this slice.
Do not execute destructive database operations or migrations.
Do not create duplicate global components or a duplicate print shell.
All Blade files must remain at or below 500 lines.
Do not commit or modify persistent migration state; checkpoint authorization will occur separately.
task_dispatch.expected_report: A TASK_REPORT containing the exact Slice 1 files created/modified, per-file line counts, confirmation that all five report types are implemented through the existing x-layouts.report-layout, confirmation of x-ui.* reuse and zero duplicate UI/print infrastructure, confirmation of modular decomposition and sub-500-line compliance, syntax/test results including R21MajorProjectControllerTest, any parity or print-layout issues discovered, whitelist compliance, and git status.
stop_conditions: Stop if implementation requires files outside the approved whitelist.
Stop if a new global UI component or print shell appears necessary; report the architectural conflict instead of creating one.
Stop if any database, migration, User.php, route, or control-plane modification would be required.
Stop after Slice 1 implementation and verification; do not begin Slice 2.
Return only the TASK_REPORT for architect review.
